about: provider.fetchSnapshot(context) against a stub world — files, secrets, commands, environment and canned responses — recording the outcome and every request made
note: A response matches on url, and on method and authorization when it names them. A request nothing matches fails as a network error. Request headers are recorded lower-cased, as HTTP treats them.
